pages.text: The Water Pump is a small pumpjack that gives an $(l)endless supply of water$(). Use it for a $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l), the $(l:nuclear/coolant_mixer)Coolant Mixer$(/l) or the $(l:generators/acid_synthesizer)Acid Synthesizer$(/l).
$(li)Stand it $(l)directly above a water source block$(), with its intake hanging into the water.$(br)$(li)Only the block below counts: water beside it does nothing.
pages.title: Placing it

pages.text: $(li)Water can't be clicked. Place the pump against a temporary block beside the spot, then remove that block.$(br)$(li)Keep it above the surface: it won't keep water out of its own block.

$(li)Give it power, for example with an $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l).$(br)$(li)It pushes the water into adjacent $(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipes$(/l) and machines.$(br)$(li)Water is a liquid: a $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l) will not take it.$(br)$(li)A pipe can plug in on any side. From below, it replaces the intake.
pages.title: Using it

pages.text: $(li)It has no GUI: $(l)right-click$() it to see what it is doing.$(br)$(li)While it pumps, the crank turns, the beam rocks and the rod goes up and down. It runs on for a few seconds after it last pumped.

$(li)$(l)Water$(): 500 mB/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Power$(): 80 FE/t$(br)In a Fission Reactor, each mB of water carries away one unit of heat. So one pump covers 500 heat per tick:$(br)$(li)$(l)Small, any power$(): 1$(br)$(li)$(l)Medium, up to 250%$(): 1$(br)$(li)$(l)Medium, above 250%$(): 2
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: $(li)A pump that stopped after an update, because it only had water at its sides, has to be moved over the water.
pages.title: Troubleshooting
